summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a research agreement with Yissum Research Development Company to study MEAI in combination with tirzepatide in diet-induced obese mice. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer disclosing a non-material preclinical research collaboration. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is described. The event is an ordinary business update, not a special situation. Form 6-K is the foreign equivalent of a U.S. Form 8-K for material events; here the press release constitutes a standard operational announcement. No deal terms apply. Filing contains no recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics relevant to special-situations.
